page.layout: Two parallel blocks: Hebrew text in the left column (upper block, then lower block), with Latin text in the right column alongside. Reading order follows the left column, then the right column.

main_text.p: fiduum pecuniæ starum ad æstivan-dum altare, & resi-duum libaminum ad vafa cultus. R. Cha-nina Sacerdotum (†) vicarius dicit; residua libaminum ad æstivandum altare, & residuum cistarum pecuniæ ad vafa cultus. Hic autem & ille respectu fructuum non confentiunt.

V. Quid fit cum refiduo (8) suffitus? Separant ab ipso mercedem (9) operariorum. Aut illud refiduum plane profanum faciunt propter mercedem operariorum [exemplar aliud, propter nummos ipsorum,] & dant illud Operariis in mercedem ipsorum. Et deinde ex (10) novis siclis novum suffitum parant.

page.notes: The Hebrew and Latin are set side by side; the Hebrew lines are given in their printed order. The bracketed phrase "[exemplar aliud, propter nummos ipsorum,]" is in smaller italic type within the column and may be a marginal or interlinear note; placed here as a note. The Hebrew word "האומני" and the variant "(נ"א מעורת)" are as printed. Some Latin words in the upper block are faint; "starum" is read as printed. Page number, running head and catchword are not visible.
